💰 PlagPro offers 4 plans:

🆓 Free – ₹0/forever
• 5 checks/month, up to 1,000 words/check

🎓 Student – ₹599/month (incl. GST)
• 100 checks/month, up to 10,000 words, PDF/Word export

💼 Professional – ₹1,499/month (incl. GST)
• Unlimited checks, 25,000 words, API access, team collaboration

🏢 Enterprise – Custom pricing
• Unlimited everything, SSO, on-premise option, dedicated manager

See full details at https://plagpro.com/pricing
